threads.title: FY27 loan growth vs market and system
threads.detail: Said 2 times, then not mentioned since Jan 2026

statements.quote: Our strategic objectives, when we laid out was that the rate of growth on loans in this year will be at market and in FY'27 will be faster than the market, predicated that the LDR will come below the 90 mark, somewhere, call it 85 to 90 or below the 90 mark, right, which is okay, that is the kind of strategic direction.
statements.speaker: Srinivasan Vaidyanathan
statements.condition: predicated that the LDR will come below the 90 mark

statements.quote: I would also like to reiterate that we shall meet the glide path that we had indicated earlier in terms of the growth, our top line growth, which is in line with the system this financial year and faster than the system in the next financial year.
statements.speaker: Sashidhar Jagdishan

statements.quote: So, I would say that from FY'27, when we get back to that kind of a growth, we should have that much of room and that much of cushion to be able to have three to four years of growth, at least, for consuming before we start to look at other options.
statements.speaker: Sashidhar Jagdishan

statements.quote: But having said that, as we have mentioned in the call, we believe that from FY'27, when we get back our trajectory, when we start to ensure that all our distribution outlets start to sell home loans, you will start to see the benefits getting more visible over a three-to five-year period.
statements.speaker: Sashidhar Jagdishan

metrics.label: Revenue growth
metrics.reading: Revenue compounded 22% a year over 5 years, 27% over 3 (accelerating); last 12 months 4%.

metrics.label: Profit growth
metrics.reading: Profit compounded 19% a year over 5 years, 18% over 3; last 12 months 11%.

metrics.label: Debt
metrics.reading: A lender borrows to lend, so debt-to-equity isn't a risk signal here; see return on equity.

bull.point: Retail assets excluding agriculture achieved an annual growth rate of 11.2% as of September 2026.
The bank maintains an open target for 3–4x growth duration support through FY27.

bear.point: Return on equity declined to 14% in FY26 from 17% in FY22.
Management stopped providing updates on the FY26 Credit-Deposit Ratio target of 90–96% after January 2026.
Revenue growth slowed significantly to 4% over the last 12 months compared to the 27% three-year average.
